newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-AJAX AMSTERDAM VS JUVENTUS TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AJAX AMSTERDAM VS JUVENTUS TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup semifinal, first leg between Ajax Amsterdam of the Netherlands and Juventus of Italy:

Ajax - 1-Edwin van der Saar; 3-Danny Blind; 4-Frank de Boer; 6-Ronald de Boer; 7-Tijani Babangida; 8-Richard Witschge; 10-Jari Litmanen; 11-Marc Overmars; 18-Kiki Musampa; 19-Arnold Scholten; 29-Mario Melchiot.

Juventus - 1-Angelo Peruzzi, 2-Ciro Ferrara, 4-Paolo Montero, 5-Sergio Porrini; 7-Angelo Di Livio, 14-Didier Deschamps, 15-Christian Vieri; 16-Nicola Amoruso; 18-Vladimir Jugovic, 21-Zinedine Zidane; 22-Gianluca Pessotto.
